definitions.explanation: The act of going to school to attend classes. Used specifically for students traveling to and arriving at their school.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{八時|はちじ}に{登校|とうこう}する。
examples.english: I go to school at eight every morning.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}のため{登校|とうこう}が{中止|ちゅうし}になった。
examples.english: School attendance was canceled due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{最近|さいきん}{登校|とうこう}を{嫌|いや}がるようになった。
examples.english: My son has recently started to resist going to school.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with する. Specifically refers to students going to school — not used for teachers or other staff (they use {出勤|しゅっきん}). The opposite is {下校|げこう} (leaving school to go home).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登校|とうこう}する (to attend school)
- {登校|とうこう}{時間|じかん} (time to go to school)
- {登校|とうこう}{拒否|きょひ} (school refusal)
- {不登校|ふとうこう} (truancy, school non-attendance)
- {登校|とうこう}{日|び} (school day)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通学|つうがく}: commuting to school — focuses on the commute itself, not the arrival
- {出席|しゅっせき}: attendance — being present at class, not the act of going
